description: Dotted-eighth tempo delay for guitar. Programs the TempoDelay FX wet-only at unity, feeds from Guitar send slot 1. Verify time against the click.
name: tempo-dotted8
notes: Precondition: FX track TempoDelay with tempo delay slot 0; Guitar send slot 1 assigned to it (one-time setup in Cubase).
Multi-track preset: select TempoDelay for calls 2-5, then select Guitar for calls 6-8. Confirm with session.status before each group.
Prefer note-sync (dotted 1/8) on the plugin itself; the process value is a start point.
Response param field shows resolved titles; try Time if Delay is not found.
Plugin mismatch names the actual insert plugin; adjust the plugin field and resend.
